summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime (pinned v1.3.13) from oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory and then invokes that downloaded runtime to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (large mixed integer/string array `n7gIxM`, rotating shift function `WV8StW`, hex-named variables) whose behavior cannot be inspected without decoding. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) and per-function string-lookup objects wrapping platform detection, HTTPS download, ZIP extraction, and `execFileSync`. The package is advertised as a React UI component catalog; fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a package-local obfuscated JS blob is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern, and it bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install` via the `preinstall` lifecycle hook and hands control to opaque code, giving whoever published this version arbitrary code execution on installer machines.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
